key_decisions.rationale: Preserves universal fall, voice, language, doubled name, question, and proverbial image.
key_decisions.before: We all fell to the ground, and I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
key_decisions.after: When we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And when we had all fallen to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves sight purpose, two transfers, Satan and God, forgiveness, allotted share, sanctified people, and faith in Jesus.
key_decisions.before: to open their eyes so they may turn from darkness to light and from Satan’s authority to God, so that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those made holy by trust in me.’
key_decisions.after: to open their eyes, so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, and receive forgiveness of sins and a place among those sanctified by faith in me.’
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to open their eyes so that they may turn from darkness to light and from the authority of Satan to God, that they may receive forgiveness of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’
